hero.headline: Bespoke AI systems for the work that still lives in inboxes, PDFs and people's heads.
hero.subline: We build private internal software for businesses with complex workflows. Documents, data and existing tools connected into one system — with human control where it counts.

problem.headline: Most AI demos don't survive their first week in production.
problem.body: Real work is full of exceptions. Permissions that don't line up, documents that arrive half-complete, approvals someone has to give, legacy systems that don't play along. That's where general-purpose tools break. That's where this work starts.

pillars.headline: Four places where AI actually changes the operation.

items.title: AI Workflow Systems
items.description: From incoming message to closed task. Extraction, checks, approval, action. Everything traceable.

items.title: Private Knowledge Systems
items.description: Internal search and answers over your own documents. Permission-aware, with the source attached, not a public API.

items.title: Document & Data Processing
items.description: PDFs, emails and forms into clean data. Uncertain records go to a human, the rest flow straight through.

items.title: Systems Integration
items.description: The connective layer between ERP, CRM, accounting and the tools people actually use. With logs and retries.

foundation.title: Custom Software Development
foundation.description: The core skill of this studio for five years. AI is a layer on top, not a replacement.

comparison.headline: Why this isn't an AI automation agency.
comparison.leadIn: Automation usually stops at the happy path. Operational work doesn't.

rows.b: System built around the real process
Stateful workflows with validation and recovery
Ships production software your team can run
Review queue, audit log, fallback, monitoring
Designed around controlled access and EU privacy

process.headline: Three stages, each with a clear boundary.

stages.title: AI Opportunity Blueprint
stages.description: We pick one workflow together, map the technical reality, and deliver a concrete build proposal. No vague sessions, no free consulting.

stages.title: Build & Launch
stages.description: We design, build and deploy the system. After that your team runs it, with documentation and a handover.
outputs: Production web app or internal system

stages.title: Continuous Improvement
stages.description: AI systems improve after launch. Monitoring, tuning, small extensions — based on real usage, not guesses.

security.headline: Permissions, provenance and accountability aren't add-ons.
security.body: These systems often touch personal, financial or contractual information. That calls for design, not promises. Access is limited to who needs it. AI answers point back to the source. Impactful actions get a human approval. Every move is auditable.

points.title: Controlled data access
points.description: Data stays inside your environment. Model choice and hosting match the sensitivity of the content.

points.title: Role-based permissions
points.description: Who can see and do what is explicit, not implicit. No shared admin accounts.

points.title: Answers with sources
points.description: AI output is tied to the source document, with page or reference.

points.title: Human approval
points.description: Actions with impact are never silently automated. Someone sees them, someone approves them.

points.title: Audit log
points.description: Every step, every change, every approval is traceable. Not a black box.

scenarios.headline: Three shapes of system we keep building.
scenarios.leadIn: Anonymised. They're cross-industry — the pattern matters, not the vertical.

items.title: PDF-to-accounting pipeline
items.description: Incoming invoices and attachments are extracted, checked against purchase orders, and queued for approval. Uncertainty goes to the right person, the rest goes to the accounting tool.

items.title: Internal SOP assistant
items.description: Staff ask questions about procedures, contracts and products. Answers come from your own documents, with the source cited and access rules respected.

items.title: Multi-system operations dashboard
items.description: ERP, CRM, ticketing and internal tools brought into one working screen. Status updates flow automatically, escalations reach the right person.

fit.headline: When this works, and when it doesn't.
yes: Your team processes many emails, PDFs, forms or spreadsheets
Important knowledge is scattered across documents and colleagues
Staff duplicate data across multiple systems
You want AI to support staff, not replace them
Standard software gets close but doesn't fit the real process
Security, permissions and traceability are non-negotiable
no: You want a marketing chat widget
A standard SaaS tool already covers the problem
You want a one-hour Zapier setup
You're looking for a speculative 'AI idea' without a real bottleneck

cta.headline: Find the workflow costing you the most time.
cta.body: Two weeks, a fixed price, a concrete build proposal. No commitment to build.
